MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - CASE
    WHEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10
      OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 14)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE age > 42
   OR p.name <> 'Fran Curran Francis Hugh Curran Sr.'
   OR p.name = 'Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr.'
   OR CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) = 1
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, p.college AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ',', 2) AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) ELSE CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'January' THEN 1 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'February' THEN 2 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'March' THEN 3 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'April' THEN 4 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'May' THEN 5 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'June' THEN 6 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'July' THEN 7 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'August' THEN 8 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'September' THEN 9 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'October' THEN 10 WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'November' THEN 11 ELSE 12 END END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(split_part(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', 1) AS INT64) END AS birth_day
WITH p, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age > 42 OR p.name <> 'Fran Curran Francis Hugh Curran Sr.' OR p.name = 'Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr.' OR CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) = 1
